tests.runner: Python unittest; temporary files, mocked host transports, isolated JavaScript VM and one owned local child process

covered: Exact staged source pair, path, application scope and loopback launch guards; required CLI activation flag and record.
Current-pointer drift, modified consumer and prior activation journal stop before service/process commands.
Atomic site and pointer replacement: preimages, concurrent edits, enabled symlink, ownership, mode, xattrs and hardlink refusal.
Captured public-environment validation and private command output; no terminal disclosure of synthetic private values.
Actual PM2_START JavaScript with SDK normalization/config mutation, retained-process drift, wrong launch, missing public values and unapproved-method refusal.
Actual PM2 cleanup JavaScript: owned activation nonce only; foreign same-name candidate is retained; unacknowledged absent prepare cannot be called clean recovery.
Tokenless WebSocket probe sends only viewer_auth, verifies the upgrade, requires auth_error then close 4403 and refuses location/success payloads without echoing them.
Actual activation/recovery ordering: early backend failure restores the old pointer and only act.service; later frontend failure retains and rechecks the authenticated backend.
Public rollback uses port 3002 with the combined asset union; concurrent routing changes withhold candidate cleanup.
PM2 persistence retains existing parsed definitions; partial failure restores exact previous bytes; concurrent dump changes are not overwritten.
SIGHUP/closed-stdout resilience, deliberate-interrupt recovery while release lock is held, and killing/reaping an owned command group on timeout.
limitations: The activation helper has not been executed on Hostinger. These checks do not establish live deployment, real installed PM2 behavior, public routing or phone GPS acceptance.
The PM2 JavaScript tests run the actual embedded code against protocol mocks. They are not a full installed-PM2 integration test.
Recovery tests use temporary files and simulated service/HTTP/PM2 readiness; no actual systemd, Nginx, production processes, backend records or provider APIs were accessed.
No application suite was repeated. Existing web/backend/mobile test evidence remains separate from these operations-helper checks.
No live booking, charge, notification, driver profile, production setting or phone journey was changed by these checks.
